name: canvas__screening_cascade
description: When a short screener such as PHQ-2 or GAD-2 comes back positive, adds the follow-up questionnaire (PHQ-9, GAD-7, or any coded questionnaire) to the same note. Rules are settings: screener, threshold, follow-up, waiting period, clinician preference and optional score write-back. Off until SCREENING_CASCADE_ENABLED is true.

handlers.description: On a committed questionnaire, scores matching screeners and originates the configured follow-up questionnaire.
